headline: Delivered in full: 6/6 runs (3 haiku, 3 sonnet) quote all three last sentences verbatim, including the one at the end of a 16,131-char parameter schema; none sees a truncation marker. Unlike descriptions, input schemas are not cut on Claude Code, at least up to ~21.7k characters per tool.
